articles.title: Kerala HC Dismisses PIL Challenging Women-Only 'Freedom at Midnight' Event
articles.excerpt: The Kerala High Court refused to entertain a petition challenging men's exclusion from a women-only Independence Day eve celebration in Thiruvananthapuram, calling it 'slipshod' and devoid of valid materials.
articles.nri_angle: The ruling reinforces India's constitutional framework for women-only public initiatives, relevant to NRIs following evolving social policy and women's rights in India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
